# Vimal Travels — AI Context File

## About
Vimal Travels is a full-service travel agency based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.
Established in 2007, with 19+ years of experience serving 5,000+ families.
IATA certified. Google Rating: 4.9/5 based on 500+ verified reviews.
